query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
        FROM items i
        WHERE i.id = ANY($1)
          AND ((i.owner_id IS NULL AND i.family_id IS NULL)
               OR can_see_scoped(i.owner_id, i.family_id, $2)
               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipt_items ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = $3 AND ri.item_id = i.id))
